intro_m01_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m01_orbit.text: Entering Vesper Gate Colony high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m01_surface.speaker: vale
intro_m01_surface.text: Lead Vale's squad through Vesper Gate and bring that Directorate relay down.

intro_m02_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m02_orbit.text: Entering White Ridge Excavation high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m02_surface.speaker: vale
intro_m02_surface.text: Build up our base, hold off the Directorate raids, and seize the artifact at White Ridge.

intro_m03_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m03_orbit.text: Entering Twilight Crossing high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m03_surface.speaker: sable
intro_m03_surface.text: Defend the bridges and keep the Colony Hub standing until my rescue ship arrives.

intro_m04_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m04_orbit.text: Entering Bracken Evacuation Corridor high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m04_surface.speaker: aster
intro_m04_surface.text: Escort Bracken's colonist trucks up the northern road to the evacuation ships.

intro_m05_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m05_orbit.text: Entering Ashfall Settlement high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m05_surface.speaker: vale
intro_m05_surface.text: Clear the infected settlement while we have daylight, and defend the barricades after dark.

intro_m06_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m06_orbit.text: Entering Redstone Tectonic Basin high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m06_surface.speaker: sable
intro_m06_surface.text: Stockpile crystal between lava surges, pull crews to high ground on my mark, and find the missing miners.

intro_m07_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m07_orbit.text: Entering Talion Sunken Temple high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m07_surface.speaker: vale
intro_m07_surface.text: Push to the sunken shrine ahead of the Brood and break the relic's Concord guardians.

intro_m08_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m08_orbit.text: Entering Sanctuary Orbital Ring high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m08_surface.speaker: aster
intro_m08_surface.text: Shatter all three orbital shield links so our interceptors can bring down the Purifier warship.

intro_m09_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m09_orbit.text: Entering Tarsus Freight Line high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m09_surface.speaker: rook
intro_m09_surface.text: Recover those abandoned Rail Skimmers and stop eight Directorate freight trains across the depot lines.

intro_m10_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m10_orbit.text: Entering Verdant Canopy high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m10_surface.speaker: aster
intro_m10_surface.text: Escort Pioneers to the jungle vents and bring seven Aether canisters safely back to the Hub.

intro_m11_orbit.speaker: helm
intro_m11_orbit.text: Entering Aurelia Sealed Vault high orbit. Strike group cleared for atmospheric descent.

intro_m11_surface.speaker: vale
intro_m11_surface.text: Reclaim the Helix laser drill and hold every approach while it cuts open the Concord vault.

intro_open_1.speaker: vance
intro_open_1.text: Frontier News Special Report: Directorate garrisons have locked down the Vesper Gate subspace relay. Martial curfew is now total, and all off-world distress calls have been silenced.

intro_open_2.speaker: rook
intro_open_2.text: Don't buy the broadcast, Vale. They cut that relay so Vesper Gate can't call for help while Directorate convoys haul our people away.

intro_open_3.speaker: vane
intro_open_3.text: Mark Four combat suit pressurized. Neosteel chestplate locked and sealed. Rifles are loaded and hot, suit's all yours, Captain.

intro_open_4.speaker: vale
intro_open_4.text: Seal the visor. Six rifles, one drop. We smash their roadblock, free the convoy, and tear that Directorate relay to the ground. On the Rampart, move!

intro_open_5.speaker: sable
intro_open_5.text: Touching down on the Vesper Gate highway! Directorate roadblock dead ahead, ramp is green, Captain, go, go, go!

cantina_early_1.speaker: rook
cantina_early_1.text: Welcome to the Vesper safehouse, Commander. Check the Job Board or hit Deploy whenever you're ready to roll out.

intro_vesper_01.speaker: sable
intro_vesper_01.text: Skimming low under Directorate radar. Vesper Gate outskirts right ahead, prepare for combat drop.

intro_vesper_02.speaker: sable
intro_vesper_02.text: Approaching the White Ridge excavation zone. Pioneers and base rigs are touching down at the staging camp.

intro_vesper_03.speaker: sable
intro_vesper_03.text: Gnarl Brood signatures closing on Dawn Reach from every canyon! Hold that outpost until my Rampart can get back for extraction!

intro_cine_1.speaker: vane
intro_cine_1.text: Reactor seals locked. Neosteel chestplate fused and pressurized. Bay Seven gantry is clear.

intro_cine_2.speaker: vale
intro_cine_2.text: Seal the visor. Three weeks in the dark is long enough. It's time Vesper Gate heard from us.

intro_cine_3.speaker: sable
intro_cine_3.text: Blast doors green! Armor columns rolling, Kestrel flight launching on my mark!

intro_cine_4.speaker: helm
intro_cine_4.text: Starfall task force clear of warp! Drop-group Alpha detaching for atmospheric entry!

intro_cine_5.speaker: aster
intro_cine_5.text: Long-range bioscans are spiking across the Rim. The Gnarl Brood is waking beneath every frontier colony!

intro_cine_6.speaker: vance
intro_cine_6.text: Caught between Directorate martial law, the Brood tide, and ancient Aurelian fleets, the outer worlds face extinction.

intro_cine_7.speaker: vale
intro_cine_7.text: Let them all come. Load the Ramparts, lock your rifles, and follow me. We're taking our worlds back!

prologue_1.speaker: vale
prologue_1.text: Three weeks ago the Directorate cut every subspace relay along the Rim and left the outer colonies in the dark.

prologue_2.speaker: vance
prologue_2.text: Directorate High Command insists the Vesper comms shutdown is routine maintenance, even as renegade flotillas gather in orbit.

prologue_3.speaker: vale
prologue_3.text: Prep the Ramparts. We break the relay at Vesper Gate first, then we bring every stranded colony home.

armory_intro_1.speaker: vane
armory_intro_1.text: Welcome to Bay Seven, Commander. Every credit you pull off Directorate contracts goes straight into heavier steel and hotter barrels.

armory_intro_2.speaker: vane
armory_intro_2.text: Step up to the Armory Console whenever you're ready to refit infantry suits, walkers, or starfighters.

cantina_intro_1.speaker: rook
cantina_intro_1.text: Jukebox is warm, F R N is spinning propaganda on the screen, and the Rim's best mercenary crews are waiting at the holo-table.

lab_intro_1.speaker: aster
lab_intro_1.text: Gnarl Brood tissue adapts under fire, and Concord crystal matrices store immense harmonic energy. Bring me samples from the field and we will turn both to our advantage.

arc1_1.speaker: vance
arc1_1.text: Subspace traffic is pouring out of Vesper Gate tonight after Captain Vale's raiders toppled the central Directorate relay tower.

arc1_2.speaker: vale
arc1_2.text: With the blackout broken, we intercepted Directorate traffic from White Ridge. They've dug up an ancient artifact, and something else is waking up.

arc2_1.speaker: sable
arc2_1.text: Last Rampart is aboard, Commander! Dawn Reach has fallen to the Gnarl Brood. Distress beacons are lighting up all along the Bracken corridor.

arc2_2.speaker: aster
arc2_2.text: Doctor Aster here. Thousands of colonists at Bracken and Ashfall will be overrun unless we escort their convoys out immediately.

arc3_1.speaker: sable
arc3_1.text: Direct hit on the Concord Purifier core! Outer colony fleets are rallying to the Starfall's transponder.

arc3_2.speaker: vale
arc3_2.text: Only Tarsus, Bel'Verdant, and the sealed vault on Aurelia Prime stand between the Rim and lasting freedom.

arc4_1.speaker: vale
arc4_1.text: The vault seal is down, the Directorate line is broken, and the frontier worlds answer to no one but themselves.

arc4_2.speaker: sable
arc4_2.text: All colonies reporting clear skies, Commander. It was an honor flying the Ashfall Signal with you.

cantina_rook_1.speaker: rook
cantina_rook_1.text: Half the frontier mercs on this deck owe Vale their lives. Put credits on the table and they'll drop into hell beside us.

rook_sector_01.text: Next drop at Vesper Gate Colony won't be a parade. Hit Bay Seven for plating upgrades before we launch.

vale_bridge_03.speaker: vale
vale_bridge_03.text: Gnarl Brood packs are converging on Dawn Reach. Hold those bridges until Sable's Rampart can pull everyone out.

vale_bridge_04.speaker: vale
vale_bridge_04.text: Bracken's colonists are out of time. Get down to the highway and escort Doctor Aster's convoy to the evac ships.

vale_bridge_08.speaker: vale
vale_bridge_08.text: A Concord Purifier warship is moving over the Sanctuary colonies. Crack its three shield links and clear the sky.

vale_bridge_10.speaker: vale
vale_bridge_10.text: We need high-purity Aether from Bel'Verdant's jungle vents before we push on Aurelia Prime. Cover our Pioneers.

frn_news_00.speaker: vance
frn_news_00.text: Directorate forces have imposed a total communications blackout over Vesper Gate, as Captain Vale's renegade flotilla drops out of warp in high orbit.

frn_news_01.speaker: vance
frn_news_01.text: Breaking news from Vesper Gate: the central Directorate relay tower has fallen, and colonial resistance fighters are rallying to the Meridian Guard banner.

frn_news_02.speaker: vance
frn_news_02.text: Sources confirm a Directorate excavation at White Ridge has been overrun following a fierce raid, with an ancient Aurelian Concord relic reported missing.

frn_news_03.speaker: vance
frn_news_03.text: Pilot Sable has executed a daring twilight extraction at Dawn Reach, pulling the Meridian garrison out moments before Gnarl Brood swarms overran the outer bridges.

frn_news_04.speaker: vance
frn_news_04.text: Over fifty colonist transports have safely cleared the Bracken corridor tonight, escaping off-world despite relentless Gnarl Brood ambushes along the northern highway.

frn_news_05.speaker: vance
frn_news_05.text: Quarantine protocols have been lifted over Ashfall Haven after Meridian Guard containment teams completed a multi-day purge of the blighted districts.

frn_news_06.speaker: vance
frn_news_06.text: Tectonic instability has peaked across Redstone Basin, yet Meridian prospectors managed to haul out a record crystal stockpile between lethal magma surges.

frn_news_07.speaker: vance
frn_news_07.text: A Meridian strike team has recovered a second sunken relic on Talion, defeating ancient Concord war-constructs just ahead of advancing Brood packs.

frn_news_08.speaker: vance
frn_news_08.text: Celebrations are erupting across Sanctuary tonight after Kestrel squadrons shattered a Concord Purifier's shield links and brought the warship down in flames.

frn_news_09.speaker: vance
frn_news_09.text: Directorate supply lines on Tarsus are in ruins after Rail Skimmer outriders intercepted and destroyed eight armored freight trains across three depot tracks.

frn_news_10.speaker: vance
frn_news_10.text: Doctor Aster's science teams on Bel'Verdant have secured seven high-purity Aether canisters from the jungle vents despite heavy Aurelian air patrols.

frn_news_11.speaker: vance
frn_news_11.text: Historic bulletin from Aurelia Prime: the Helix laser drill has breached the sealed vault, breaking the Directorate's grip and uniting the free frontier.
